architecture.deployment: GitHub Pages uploads the committed public/ directory directly. No static-report builder is run in the current pages workflow.
architecture.important: Hourly market automation updates data JSON only. It must not rewrite HTML/JS/CSS. UI changes are explicit versioned changes only.

v030_regressions_fixed: Restored persistent dynamic-button styles after v0.2.9 lost required v0.2.8 inline styles
TradingView detail charts default to daily and are enlarged on mobile and PC
Modal background scroll isolation/back-navigation behavior preserved
ui_invariants: PC and mobile expose the same information
No browser-default white rectangular buttons in dynamic sections
Large sections are rounded foldable panels
Android/browser back while modal is open closes modal instead of leaving app/page
Custom interval buttons are not shown
Actual charts are large enough to inspect without opening a separate page
Left-top subtitle shows actual latest data update as YYYY.MM.DD H시 업데이트
must_render_sections: hourly buy-timing and QQQ price charts
stable long-term compounders grouped by theme and rank

phase_rule.comment_required: Every phase/state must include 그래서 지금은? action guidance. Non-cyclical structural/quality assets use current-state evaluation instead of forced cycle labels.

automation_rule: Every hourly run updates latest.json, intraday.json, phase-status.json and same-day archive with verified data; writes updated_at in KST; never invents prices; does not rewrite UI files.
security: No actual user holdings/weights/account information in this public repo
No tokens, passwords, OTPs, private keys, or secrets
No manual user holdings input UI
release_rule: For UI releases, keep VERSION, public/index.html, public/reports/latest.html, cache keys, and pages.yml verification in sync.
